Changing the angle is cheap and I can do it now. Changing the format would retire most of the screens work built this week and would need the beat assignment reopened.

chambray, likeness and the inn room all hold

selfie_angle_test.diagnosis: The prompt alone cannot move the angle, because the IMAGE reference anchors framing. EP009's locked still, L3-chambray, is a landscape camera-level shot of him seated at a table. The Wednesday takes work because their reference still, E2-office-charcoal-groomed, was itself generated at the selfie angle, and their prompt then says 'lighting and framing exactly as in the IMAGE'.
selfie_angle_test.implied_next_step: Generate EP009 look candidates at the phone-above-eye-level angle, keeping the locked chambray and inn, and have the owner pick one the way they picked E2. That still then becomes the image reference for all eight takes. It is a look-lock step, so it is the owner's pick, not mine.
selfie_angle_test.limitation: 480p draft, six seconds, no audio, no behaviour references. Framing only.
